assets.title: Root-Flared Broken Stump
assets.description: Original S02 hard-edge faceted standing tree stump. Five unequal buttress root flares flow into an offset tapered trunk in one continuous closed mesh. An irregular broken bark rim and angled exposed sapwood surround a solid eccentric heartwood section, with two subtle annual bands and a modeled radial V fissure. Metres, trunk-centre ground origin Z=0, named editable continuous mesh and solid untextured PBR. Original geometry, not a stripped anvil base or a rotated fallen log. Static natural ground dressing only; no decorative axe, mushrooms, collision mesh, physics, wind rig, animation or species-accuracy guarantee.
